id-20260816-intro-real-estate-13.title: [Real Estate 101 #13] Who Actually Pays Your Agent — and What They Legally Owe You

segments.src:
> Jasa perantara properti berdiri di atas tiga hal: perjanjian yang jelas, komisi yang disepakati di depan, dan pengecekan dokumen yang mencegah sengketa — dan yang ketiga inilah yang paling sering dilewati orang.

## Konsep Hari Ini

Agen properti bukan pemilik barang. Ia perantara: mempertemukan penjual dan pembeli, lalu dibayar dari jasa mempertemukan itu. Karena tidak memiliki barangnya, seluruh pekerjaannya bertumpu pada tiga pilar.

**Pilar 1 — Perjanjian jasa pemasaran (listing).**
Ini kontrak antara pemilik properti dan agen. Isinya sederhana tapi menentukan segalanya: harga penawaran, jangka waktu, siapa yang menanggung biaya iklan, dan besaran komisi. Di praktik pasar Indonesia ada tiga bentuk umum:

- **Listing terbuka (open listing):** pemilik menitipkan rumahnya ke banyak agen sekaligus. Yang berhasil menjual, itu yang dapat komisi. Terkesan menguntungkan pemilik, tapi efeknya sering sebaliknya — satu rumah muncul di lima platform dengan lima harga berbeda, dan calon pembeli langsung curiga.
- **Listing eksklusif:** hanya satu agen selama periode tertentu (biasanya 3–6 bulan). Agen berani keluar biaya foto, video, dan iklan berbayar karena risikonya terukur.
- **Listing bersama (multiple listing):** eksklusif ke satu agen, tapi agen itu membagikan datanya ke jaringan kantor lain dan komisi dibagi antara agen penjual dan agen pembeli.

**Pilar 2 — Komisi (fee jasa perantara).**
Dasar hukum utamanya di Indonesia adalah Permendag No. 51 Tahun 2017 tentang Perusahaan Perantara Perdagangan Properti. Aturan itu menetapkan komisi berdasarkan kesepakatan, namun **paling sedikit 2% dari nilai transaksi**, dan dibayar oleh pihak pemberi tugas — umumnya penjual. Di pasar sekunder rumah tinggal, angka yang lazim berkisar 2–3%. Untuk transaksi sewa, praktik pasar biasanya memakai persentase dari nilai sewa setahun, bukan dari harga jual properti.

Yang sering memicu ribut bukan besarannya, melainkan **kapan komisi dianggap lahir**. Apakah saat pembeli membayar tanda jadi? Saat PPJB ditandatangani? Atau saat AJB tuntas di hadapan PPAT? Tulis titik itu di perjanjian sejak awal. Tulis juga apa yang terjadi kalau transaksi batal karena KPR pembeli ditolak bank.

**Pilar 3 — Pencegahan sengketa (yang paling sering dilewati).**
Kerugian terbesar di jasa properti hampir tidak pernah datang dari salah pasang harga. Datangnya dari dokumen. Daftar periksa minimalnya:

- Cek keaslian dan status sertifikat langsung ke Kantor Pertanahan/BPN — bukan cukup melihat fotokopinya.
- Pastikan nama di sertifikat sama dengan KTP penjual. Kalau pemilik sudah meninggal, wajib balik nama waris dulu.
- Kalau properti adalah harta bersama, butuh persetujuan pasangan secara tertulis.
- Periksa tunggakan PBB, IPL, listrik, dan air.
- Pastikan tidak ada blokir, sita, atau sengketa batas.
- Uang pembeli **tidak boleh** masuk ke rekening pribadi agen. Titik.
- Semua uang muka pakai kuitansi dan perjanjian tertulis, dan akta jual beli dibuat di hadapan PPAT.

Agen yang legal juga punya izin usaha perantara properti (SIU-P4) dan sertifikat kompetensi. Menanyakannya bukan tindakan kurang sopan — itu bagian dari uji tuntas Anda.

## Dalam Keseharian

Pak Rian mau menjual rumahnya di Bintaro, harga penawaran Rp 1,2 miliar. Ia titipkan ke empat agen sekaligus tanpa kontrak tertulis, karena "biar cepat laku".

Tiga bulan berlalu. Rumah itu tayang di marketplace dengan empat harga: Rp 1,2 M, Rp 1,25 M, Rp 1,19 M, dan satu lagi tanpa harga. Calon pembeli yang serius mundur — mereka menyimpulkan penjualnya bingung atau rumahnya bermasalah.

Pak Rian akhirnya memilih satu agen dengan listing eksklusif 4 bulan, komisi 2,5%, dibayar saat AJB tuntas. Hitungannya lugas:

```
Komisi = 2,5% × Rp 1.200.000.000 = Rp 30.000.000
```

Rp 30 juta terasa besar. Tapi lihat apa yang terjadi kemudian.

Saat pengecekan dokumen, ketahuan sertifikat masih atas nama almarhum ayah Pak Rian. Kalau transaksi jalan terus tanpa balik nama waris, AJB tidak bisa dibuat dan uang pembeli bisa tertahan berbulan-bulan. Agen menahan proses, mengurus surat keterangan waris lebih dulu.

Berikutnya, calon pembeli menawar dan minta mentransfer tanda jadi Rp 50 juta ke rekening pribadi agen "biar praktis". Agen menolak, dan mengarahkan pembayaran melalui rekening penjual dengan kuitansi bermeterai serta perjanjian pengikatan jual beli di notaris.

Bandingkan ongkosnya. Komisi Rp 30 juta adalah biaya yang diketahui di depan. Sengketa waris yang meledak setelah uang berpindah bisa menahan aset Rp 1,2 miliar selama satu-dua tahun di pengadilan, ditambah biaya pengacara. Itulah alasan komisi bukan sekadar bayaran untuk "mempertemukan orang" — ia bayaran untuk verifikasi yang bikin transaksi selamat.

Catatan penting: kalau agen Anda hanya sibuk memotret rumah dan tidak pernah menyebut sertifikat, PBB, atau status perkawinan penjual, Anda sedang membayar 2,5% untuk jasa fotografi.

## Rangkuman 3 Baris

1. Perjanjian listing menentukan harga, jangka waktu, dan komisi; listing terbuka tanpa kontrak justru sering membuat harga jadi kacau dan pembeli mundur.
2. Berdasarkan Permendag No. 51/2017, komisi perantara properti minimal 2% dari nilai transaksi dan dibayar pemberi tugas — dan titik "kapan komisi lahir" harus ditulis sejak awal.
3. Nilai terbesar seorang agen ada di pencegahan sengketa: cek sertifikat ke BPN, cocokkan nama pemilik, pastikan persetujuan pasangan, dan jangan pernah kirim uang ke rekening pribadi agen.

## ✅ Kuis Mandiri

**1.** Menurut Permendag No. 51 Tahun 2017, berapa besaran minimal komisi perantara perdagangan properti?
- A. 1% dari nilai transaksi
- B. 2% dari nilai transaksi
- C. 5% dari nilai transaksi
- D. Tidak ada ketentuan minimal, sepenuhnya bebas

**2.** (O/X) Pada listing eksklusif, pemilik menitipkan propertinya ke sebanyak mungkin agen agar cepat laku.

**3.** Manakah praktik yang paling berisiko bagi pembeli?
- A. Membayar tanda jadi ke rekening pribadi agen tanpa kuitansi
- B. Mengecek keaslian sertifikat ke Kantor Pertanahan
- C. Membuat AJB di hadapan PPAT
- D. Meminta persetujuan tertulis pasangan penjual

## 📚 Istilah Hari Ini

- **Listing eksklusif** — perjanjian yang memberi hak pemasaran kepada satu agen saja untuk jangka waktu tertentu.
- **Komisi perantara** — imbalan jasa agen, minimal 2% dari nilai transaksi menurut Permendag No. 51/2017, dibayar oleh pemberi tugas.
- **PPJB** — Perjanjian Pengikatan Jual Beli; perjanjian pendahuluan saat syarat jual beli (misalnya pelunasan atau balik nama) belum terpenuhi.
- **AJB** — Akta Jual Beli; akta peralihan hak yang dibuat di hadapan PPAT dan menjadi dasar balik nama sertifikat.
- **PPAT** — Pejabat Pembuat Akta Tanah; pejabat berwenang membuat akta peralihan hak atas tanah dan bangunan.
- **SIU-P4** — Surat Izin Usaha Perusahaan Perantara Perdagangan Properti; izin usaha yang wajib dimiliki kantor agen properti resmi.

---

*Jawaban: 1) B — Permendag No. 51/2017 menetapkan komisi berdasarkan kesepakatan namun paling sedikit 2% dari nilai transaksi. 2) X — itu ciri listing terbuka; listing eksklusif justru menunjuk satu agen saja dalam periode tertentu. 3) A — mengirim uang ke rekening pribadi agen tanpa kuitansi menghapus jejak hukum pembayaran; pilihan B, C, dan D justru merupakan langkah pengamanan transaksi.*
segments.tr:
> A real estate agent's job is defined by three documents and one signature: the agreement that hires them, the clause that pays them, and the disclosures that keep everyone out of court.

## 오늘의 개념

Most people meet a real estate agent the way they meet a waiter — someone friendly shows up, shows you things, and a bill appears at the end. That mental model is wrong, and it's the source of nearly every complaint filed with a state real estate commission.

Brokerage practice rests on three pillars.

**1. The agreement that creates the relationship.**
An agent does not represent you because they were nice to you. They represent you because you signed something. On the seller's side that's a **listing agreement**; on the buyer's side, a **buyer representation agreement**. In most states these must be in writing to be enforceable (a consequence of the *statute of frauds*), and they must state a definite expiration date — no open-ended contracts.

Listings come in flavors, and the difference is worth real money:

- **Exclusive right to sell** — the listing broker is paid if the home sells during the term, *no matter who finds the buyer*, including the seller's own cousin. This is the standard listing in the U.S.
- **Exclusive agency** — the broker is paid only if the broker (or another agent) produces the buyer. If the seller finds the buyer alone, no commission.
- **Open listing** — the seller can hire many brokers; only the one who produces the buyer gets paid. Rare in residential.

**2. The compensation clause.**
Commission is *negotiable, always, and by law it has to be.* No state, no association, and no MLS may set or suggest a standard rate — doing so is price fixing under federal antitrust law. What varies is who pays whom, and since the National Association of Realtors' settlement practice changes took effect on **August 17, 2024**, two things changed nationally: offers of compensation to buyer's agents can no longer be published on an MLS, and an agent who is an MLS participant must have a signed written agreement with a buyer *before* touring a home with them. Sellers can still agree to cover the buyer's agent — it's just negotiated in the deal now rather than advertised in the listing feed.

**3. The duties, and the ways agents get sued.**
When an agent represents you as an agent (rather than as a neutral facilitator), they owe **fiduciary duties**: loyalty, confidentiality, obedience to lawful instructions, disclosure of material facts, reasonable care, and accounting for money held. Commissions are the fun part of the job; these duties are the part that generates lawsuits.

The recurring failure modes are boringly consistent: not disclosing a known material defect, practicing law or appraisal without a license ("don't worry, that easement is fine"), sloppy handling of earnest money, and **undisclosed dual agency** — representing both sides without written informed consent. Some states have decided the conflict is unmanageable and banned dual agency outright; Florida and Colorado, for example, use a neutral **transaction broker** model instead. This is why brokerages carry **errors and omissions (E&O) insurance** and why the file — every text, every disclosure, every signed addendum — is the agent's real defense.

## 일상 속에서

Say you're selling a townhouse in Raleigh, North Carolina for **$425,000**.

You sign a 6-month exclusive right to sell listing at a negotiated **5% total commission**, with your listing agreement authorizing you to offer **2.5%** to a buyer's agent if a buyer's agent is involved. At closing:

```
Sale price                 $425,000
Total commission (5%)      $ 21,250
  Listing brokerage 2.5%   $ 10,625
  Buyer brokerage 2.5%     $ 10,625
```

That $10,625 does not go to your agent. It goes to the **broker**, who splits it with the agent under their internal agreement — a 50/50 new-agent split leaves $5,312.50 before franchise fees, MLS dues, marketing costs, and self-employment tax. Understanding this changes how you negotiate: you're negotiating with a business that has a cost floor, not with a person pocketing $21,250.

Now the parts that actually bite.

**Month 4:** your neighbor offers to buy directly. Under an *exclusive right to sell*, your broker is still owed the commission. Under an *exclusive agency* listing, they aren't. One word in a contract you skimmed, $21,250 of difference.

**Month 5:** your agent brings a buyer they also represent. In North Carolina that's legal only with the prior written consent of both parties, and the agent must stop advising either side on price and terms. If they never asked — that's a license complaint.

**Closing day:** you get an email that looks exactly like your closing attorney's, with updated wire instructions and a "please hurry" note. This is the single most expensive mistake in modern residential real estate. The FBI's Internet Crime Complaint Center logs thousands of real estate wire fraud complaints a year, with losses in the hundreds of millions of dollars, and wired funds are often unrecoverable within hours. **Never accept wire instructions by email.** Call the closing office at a number you looked up yourself — not one printed in the email — and verify every digit.

## 3줄 정리

1. An agency relationship — and the duty to protect your interests — begins with a signed listing or buyer representation agreement, not with a handshake.
2. Commission is negotiable by law, paid to the *broker* and split from there; since August 2024 it's negotiated inside the transaction rather than advertised on the MLS.
3. Most brokerage disasters are preventable paperwork problems: undisclosed dual agency, unwritten material defects, and wire instructions verified by phone.

## ✅ 셀프 퀴즈

**Q1.** You sign a 6-month **exclusive right to sell** listing. In month 3 you find a buyer entirely on your own. Does the listing broker earn a commission?
- (A) Yes, the full negotiated commission
- (B) No, because the broker didn't produce the buyer
- (C) Only half, automatically

**Q2. (O/X)** Since the August 2024 practice changes, U.S. real estate commissions follow a standard national rate set by the industry.

**Q3.** Two days before closing you receive an email from your title company with new wire instructions. What's the correct move?
- (A) Reply to the email asking them to confirm
- (B) Call the title company at a number you independently verified and confirm the instructions
- (C) Wire a small test amount first, then the rest

## 📚 오늘의 용어

- **Listing agreement** — The written contract in which a seller hires a broker to market the property, setting the term, price, and compensation.
- **Exclusive right to sell** — The listing type where the broker is paid on any sale during the term, regardless of who found the buyer.
- **Buyer representation agreement** — The written contract hiring a broker to represent a buyer; required before touring homes with an MLS-participant agent as of August 17, 2024.
- **Fiduciary duty** — The agent's legal obligations to a client: loyalty, confidentiality, obedience, disclosure, reasonable care, and accounting.
- **Dual agency** — One brokerage representing both buyer and seller; permitted only with written informed consent in some states, and prohibited in others.
- **E&O insurance** — Errors and omissions coverage protecting brokers against claims of professional negligence or misrepresentation.

---

*정답: **Q1 — (A).** "Exclusive right to sell" means the commission is earned on any sale during the term; a seller who wants a carve-out for self-found buyers needs an exclusive agency listing or a negotiated exclusion clause written into the contract. **Q2 — X (False).** Rates have never been standardized — setting or suggesting a uniform rate is price fixing under antitrust law. The 2024 changes removed compensation offers from the MLS and required written buyer agreements; they did not create a standard rate. **Q3 — (B).** Fraudulent wire instructions arrive from spoofed or compromised email accounts, so replying only reaches the attacker. Verify by voice at an independently sourced number; a "test wire" still sends real money to a criminal account.*

*This is general educational content, not legal advice. Agency rules, dual agency legality, and disclosure requirements are set state by state — check your state's real estate commission before you sign.*

id-20260816-news-2.title: Danantara Disburses Rp225 Trillion for 26 Projects, Partners with Brazilian Meat Giant JBS Worth Rp44.6 Trillion

segments.src: Badan Pengelola Investasi Daya Anagata Nusantara (Danantara) dilaporkan terus memperluas jejak investasinya di berbagai sektor strategis.
segments.tr: The Daya Anagata Nusantara Investment Management Agency (Danantara) is reportedly continuing to expand its investment footprint across various strategic sectors.

segments.src: Berdasarkan informasi yang beredar, lembaga pengelola aset negara ini telah menggelontorkan dana hingga sekitar Rp225 triliun untuk mendukung 26 proyek yang tersebar di berbagai bidang, mulai dari hilirisasi sumber daya alam hingga ketahanan pangan.
segments.tr: Based on circulating information, this state asset management institution has disbursed funds of up to approximately Rp225 trillion to support 26 projects spread across various fields, ranging from natural resource downstreaming to food security.

segments.src: ## Kemitraan dengan JBS Group
segments.tr: ## Partnership with JBS Group

segments.src: Salah satu langkah yang menyita perhatian publik adalah rencana kemitraan dengan JBS Group, perusahaan pengolahan daging asal Brasil yang dikenal sebagai salah satu pemain terbesar di industri protein hewani dunia.
segments.tr: One move that has captured public attention is the planned partnership with JBS Group, a meat processing company from Brazil known as one of the largest players in the global animal protein industry.

segments.src: Nilai kerja sama ini disebut-sebut mencapai sekitar Rp44,6 triliun, dan menjadi bagian dari upaya Danantara memperkuat portofolio di sektor pangan dan hilirisasi.
segments.tr: The value of this collaboration is said to reach approximately Rp44.6 trillion, and it is part of Danantara's efforts to strengthen its portfolio in the food and downstreaming sectors.

segments.src: Kolaborasi dengan JBS ini dipandang sebagai langkah untuk memperkuat rantai pasok protein nasional, mengingat kebutuhan konsumsi daging dalam negeri yang terus meningkat seiring pertumbuhan penduduk.
segments.tr: The collaboration with JBS is seen as a step to strengthen the national protein supply chain, given the domestic demand for meat consumption that continues to rise alongside population growth.

segments.src: Jika terealisasi, kemitraan ini berpotensi membuka peluang transfer teknologi pengolahan, standar keamanan pangan, hingga perluasan kapasitas produksi di dalam negeri.
segments.tr: If realized, this partnership has the potential to open up opportunities for processing technology transfer, food safety standards, and the expansion of domestic production capacity.

segments.src: ## Fokus pada Hilirisasi dan Ketahanan Pangan
segments.tr: ## Focus on Downstreaming and Food Security

segments.src: Selain kerja sama dengan JBS, sebagian besar dari total dana yang telah disalurkan Danantara disebut diarahkan pada proyek-proyek hilirisasi, termasuk pengolahan komoditas sumber daya alam menjadi produk bernilai tambah lebih tinggi.
segments.tr: In addition to the cooperation with JBS, a large portion of the total funds already disbursed by Danantara is said to be directed at downstreaming projects, including the processing of natural resource commodities into higher value-added products.

segments.src: Strategi ini sejalan dengan agenda besar pemerintah untuk mengurangi ketergantungan pada ekspor bahan mentah dan mendorong industrialisasi di dalam negeri.
segments.tr: This strategy is in line with the government's major agenda to reduce dependence on raw material exports and encourage domestic industrialization.

segments.src: Sektor pangan turut menjadi perhatian khusus, mengingat isu ketahanan pangan nasional yang kerap menjadi topik penting dalam kebijakan ekonomi jangka panjang.
segments.tr: The food sector is also receiving special attention, given the issue of national food security, which is often an important topic in long-term economic policy.

segments.src: Investasi di sektor ini diharapkan dapat membantu menstabilkan pasokan sekaligus menekan ketergantungan pada impor sejumlah komoditas pangan strategis.
segments.tr: Investment in this sector is expected to help stabilize supply while reducing dependence on imports of a number of strategic food commodities.

segments.src: ## Sorotan terhadap Tata Kelola
segments.tr: ## Spotlight on Governance

segments.src: Di sisi lain, langkah ekspansif Danantara ini muncul di tengah perhatian publik terhadap aspek tata kelola lembaga tersebut.
segments.tr: On the other hand, this expansive move by Danantara comes amidst public attention regarding the governance aspects of the institution.

segments.src: Sejumlah kalangan menyoroti pentingnya transparansi dan akuntabilitas dalam pengelolaan dana investasi berskala besar seperti ini, mengingat dampaknya yang luas terhadap keuangan negara dan kepercayaan investor.
segments.tr: A number of parties have highlighted the importance of transparency and accountability in managing large-scale investment funds like this, given their broad impact on state finances and investor confidence.

segments.src: Pengamat ekonomi menilai bahwa penguatan mekanisme pengawasan, pelaporan yang terbuka, serta kejelasan kriteria pemilihan mitra investasi menjadi hal krusial agar setiap proyek yang didanai dapat memberikan manfaat optimal bagi perekonomian nasional.
segments.tr: Economic observers assess that strengthening oversight mechanisms, open reporting, and clarity in the criteria for selecting investment partners are crucial so that every funded project can provide optimal benefits for the national economy.

segments.src: Hal ini dianggap penting terutama karena skala dana yang dikelola terus bertambah seiring bertambahnya jumlah proyek strategis yang digarap.
segments.tr: This is considered important especially because the scale of funds managed continues to grow along with the increasing number of strategic projects being undertaken.

segments.src: ## Prospek ke Depan
segments.tr: ## Future Outlook

segments.src: Dengan total investasi yang telah mencapai ratusan triliun rupiah untuk puluhan proyek, langkah Danantara ke depan akan terus dipantau berbagai pihak, baik dari sisi pelaku pasar, akademisi, maupun masyarakat umum.
segments.tr: With total investments already reaching hundreds of trillions of rupiah for dozens of projects, Danantara's future steps will continue to be monitored by various parties, including market players, academics, and the general public.

segments.src: Keberhasilan kemitraan seperti dengan JBS Group berpotensi menjadi tolok ukur bagaimana lembaga ini mengelola investasi lintas sektor, sekaligus menjawab tantangan terkait tata kelola yang selama ini menjadi sorotan.
segments.tr: The success of partnerships such as the one with JBS Group has the potential to become a benchmark for how this institution manages cross-sector investments, while simultaneously addressing the challenges related to governance that have been in the spotlight.

segments.src: Perkembangan lebih lanjut mengenai realisasi proyek-proyek ini, termasuk detail teknis kerja sama dengan JBS, diperkirakan akan terus bergulir dan menjadi perhatian dalam beberapa waktu ke depan.
segments.tr: Further developments regarding the realization of these projects, including technical details of the cooperation with JBS, are expected to continue to unfold and become a focus in the time to come.

id-20260816-news-1.title: M7.7 Earthquake Shakes Flores, NTT: Dozens of Casualties, Airports and Ports Completely Paralyzed

segments.src: ## Gempa Besar Guncang Wilayah Utara Nagekeo
segments.tr: ## Major Earthquake Shakes Northern Nagekeo Region

segments.src: Gempa bumi berkekuatan magnitudo 7,7 mengguncang wilayah utara Kabupaten Nagekeo, Nusa Tenggara Timur (NTT), pada Sabtu, 15 Agustus 2026.
segments.tr: A 7.7 magnitude earthquake struck the northern region of Nagekeo Regency, East Nusa Tenggara (NTT), on Saturday, August 15, 2026.

segments.src: Badan Meteorologi, Klimatologi, dan Geofisika (BMKG) melaporkan bahwa gempa tersebut berpusat di kedalaman dangkal, sehingga guncangannya dirasakan sangat kuat oleh warga di sejumlah kabupaten sekitar, termasuk Ende, Ngada, Sikka, dan Manggarai.
segments.tr: The Meteorology, Climatology, and Geophysics Agency (BMKG) reported that the earthquake was centered at a shallow depth, causing the shaking to be felt very strongly by residents in a number of surrounding regencies, including Ende, Ngada, Sikka, and Manggarai.

segments.src: Karena karakteristik gempa dangkal dengan kekuatan besar, BMKG langsung mengeluarkan **peringatan dini tsunami** untuk wilayah pesisir utara Flores dan sekitarnya tak lama setelah guncangan terjadi.
segments.tr: Due to the characteristics of a shallow earthquake with high magnitude, BMKG immediately issued a **tsunami early warning** for the northern coastal areas of Flores and its surroundings shortly after the shaking occurred.

segments.src: Warga di kawasan pesisir diimbau segera mengungsi ke tempat yang lebih tinggi sesuai prosedur evakuasi bencana.
segments.tr: Residents in coastal areas were urged to immediately evacuate to higher ground in accordance with disaster evacuation procedures.

segments.src: ## Dampak Korban dan Kerusakan
segments.tr: ## Casualties and Damage Impact

segments.src: Berdasarkan data sementara yang dihimpun dari instansi terkait seperti Badan Penanggulangan Bencana Daerah (BPBD) dan Badan Nasional Penanggulangan Bencana (BNPB), gempa ini dilaporkan menyebabkan **puluhan korban jiwa**, dengan kemungkinan jumlah tersebut masih akan berubah seiring proses pendataan dan pencarian korban yang terus berlangsung.
segments.tr: Based on preliminary data collected from relevant agencies such as the Regional Disaster Management Agency (BPBD) and the National Disaster Management Authority (BNPB), the earthquake was reported to have caused **dozens of fatalities**, with the possibility that this number may still change as data collection and victim search operations continue.

segments.src: Selain korban jiwa, sejumlah warga dilaporkan mengalami luka-luka dan sebagian bangunan permukiman mengalami kerusakan akibat guncangan kuat maupun dampak susulan gelombang tinggi di kawasan pesisir.
segments.tr: In addition to fatalities, a number of residents were reported injured and some residential buildings suffered damage due to strong shaking and the subsequent impact of high waves in coastal areas.

segments.src: Perlu digarisbawahi bahwa angka resmi korban dan kerusakan masih bersifat sementara.
segments.tr: It should be emphasized that the official figures for casualties and damage are still preliminary.

segments.src: Masyarakat diimbau untuk merujuk pada rilis resmi dari BNPB, BPBD setempat, dan BMKG guna mendapatkan informasi terkini yang telah terverifikasi.
segments.tr: The public is urged to refer to official releases from BNPB, local BPBD, and BMKG to obtain the latest verified information.

segments.src: ## Infrastruktur Transportasi Lumpuh
segments.tr: ## Transportation Infrastructure Paralyzed

segments.src: Salah satu dampak paling signifikan dari bencana ini adalah lumpuhnya jalur transportasi udara dan laut di kawasan NTT.
segments.tr: One of the most significant impacts of this disaster is the paralysis of air and sea transportation routes in the NTT region.

segments.src: Setidaknya **lima bandara** di wilayah terdampak dilaporkan mengalami kerusakan pada landasan pacu maupun fasilitas terminal, sehingga sementara waktu tidak dapat beroperasi.
segments.tr: At least **five airports** in the affected areas were reported to have suffered damage to their runways and terminal facilities, making them temporarily inoperable.

segments.src: Selain itu, **dua pelabuhan** utama yang menjadi jalur logistik dan penyeberangan antarpulau turut mengalami kerusakan berat pada dermaga dan fasilitas pendukungnya.
segments.tr: In addition, **two main ports** that serve as logistics and inter-island crossing routes also experienced heavy damage to their piers and supporting facilities.

segments.src: Lumpuhnya bandara dan pelabuhan ini berdampak langsung pada terhambatnya distribusi bantuan kemanusiaan serta menyulitkan proses evakuasi warga dari daerah terisolasi.
segments.tr: The paralysis of these airports and ports has a direct impact on hindering the distribution of humanitarian aid and complicating the evacuation process of residents from isolated areas.

segments.src: Otoritas terkait, termasuk Kementerian Perhubungan dan pengelola bandara/pelabuhan setempat, dilaporkan tengah melakukan asesmen cepat terhadap tingkat kerusakan guna mempercepat pemulihan jalur akses.
segments.tr: Relevant authorities, including the Ministry of Transportation and local airport/port operators, are reported to be conducting rapid assessments of the damage level to accelerate the recovery of access routes.

segments.src: ## Upaya Tanggap Darurat
segments.tr: ## Emergency Response Efforts

segments.src: Tim gabungan yang terdiri dari Badan Nasional Pencarian dan Pertolongan (Basarnas), TNI, Polri, BPBD, serta relawan kemanusiaan dilaporkan telah dikerahkan ke lokasi terdampak untuk melakukan pencarian dan evakuasi korban, sekaligus mendistribusikan bantuan darurat berupa logistik, tenda pengungsian, dan layanan medis.
segments.tr: A joint team consisting of the National Search and Rescue Agency (Basarnas), the Indonesian National Armed Forces (TNI), the National Police (Polri), BPBD, and humanitarian volunteers has reportedly been deployed to the affected locations to search for and evacuate victims, while distributing emergency aid in the form of logistics, evacuation tents, and medical services.

segments.src: Karena akses darat, laut, dan udara yang sebagian besar terputus, proses pengiriman bantuan menghadapi tantangan besar.
segments.tr: Due to land, sea, and air access being largely cut off, the aid delivery process faces major challenges.

segments.src: Pemerintah daerah dilaporkan mengupayakan jalur alternatif, termasuk pemanfaatan helikopter untuk menjangkau wilayah yang paling parah terisolasi.
segments.tr: The local government is reportedly pursuing alternative routes, including the use of helicopters to reach the most severely isolated areas.

segments.src: ## Imbauan bagi Masyarakat
segments.tr: ## Appeal to the Public

segments.src: Warga di wilayah NTT dan sekitarnya diimbau untuk:
segments.tr: Residents in the NTT region and its surroundings are urged to:

segments.src: - Tetap tenang namun waspada terhadap kemungkinan **gempa susulan**.
segments.tr: - Remain calm but alert to the possibility of **aftershocks**.

segments.src: - Mengikuti arahan resmi dari BPBD, BNPB, dan BMKG terkait status peringatan tsunami.
segments.tr: - Follow official directions from BPBD, BNPB, and BMKG regarding the tsunami warning status.

segments.src: - Menghindari kawasan pesisir hingga dinyatakan aman oleh pihak berwenang.
segments.tr: - Avoid coastal areas until declared safe by the authorities.

segments.src: - Memverifikasi informasi hanya melalui kanal resmi pemerintah untuk menghindari berita yang belum terkonfirmasi (hoaks).
segments.tr: - Verify information only through official government channels to avoid unconfirmed news (hoaxes).

segments.src: - Bagi yang memiliki keluarga di wilayah terdampak, dapat menghubungi posko bantuan resmi setempat untuk informasi terbaru.
segments.tr: - For those who have family in the affected areas, they can contact the local official aid post for the latest information.

segments.src: Situasi di lapangan masih terus berkembang, dan pembaruan resmi mengenai jumlah korban, status infrastruktur, serta proses pemulihan akan terus disampaikan oleh instansi berwenang seiring berjalannya waktu.
segments.tr: The situation in the field continues to evolve, and official updates regarding the number of casualties, infrastructure status, and recovery processes will continue to be delivered by authorized agencies over time.
